Fish occupies about 48 by 30 logical pixels inside an intended 64 by 64 logical-pixel canvas. Crisp square pixel steps, large readable features, consistent pixel density; it should look easy for a beginner to redraw in Aseprite, not a high-detail illustration. No landscape, no water, no bubbles, no glow, no gradients, no smoothing, no antialiasing, no cast shadow, no grid, no checkerboard painted into the image, no labels or border. Genuine transparent alpha background. Output only this one fish.
